title: Repeat Rates on Bag Weight and Size Charges
content:
**Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — repeat weight and size charges.** The weight-or-size list charge of a checked bag is multiplied by the **repeat rate**, which follows the weight and size entries already standing on the ticket. The rate acts on the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Weight and size entries already standing on the ticket | Repeat rate |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 1.2 |
| Exactly one | 1.1 |
| None | 1 |

Every overweight entry and every oversize entry recorded on the ticket counts, whichever bag, segment or direction it belongs to.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Entries on the ticket | Rate |
|---|---|
| One overweight entry on the outbound | 1.1 |
| One overweight and one oversize entry | 1.2 |
| Three overweight entries | 1.2 |
| No weight or size entry | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A list charge of 110 dollars at a repeat rate of 1.1 becomes 121.00 dollars.
